variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photorealistic apartment interior layout concept, Dusk theme, native 1536x1024 PNG landscape.
Input image: the provided image is the EDIT TARGET, not just inspiration.
Primary request: create a truly different furniture arrangement in this exact narrow combined living and dining room of a 75.1 m² apartment. Keep the exact camera position, lens, crop, perspective, ceiling height and ceiling geometry, back entry door, left glazed opening, wall positions, floor and narrow apartment scale of the target.
Change the arrangement as follows:
1. Remove the television and console from the LEFT foreground wall. Move a slim premium burgundy leather sofa onto that LEFT foreground wall, in the place previously occupied by the TV and console, facing RIGHT. The sofa must be compact, with fine slim arms, natural leather grain and wrinkles, and must stop well before the left glazed doorway so that opening remains completely clear.
2. Remove the sofa from the RIGHT. Put the flat television on the RIGHT wood-paneled foreground wall, replacing the large artwork there. Place a slim low dark walnut television console directly below it, aligned to that wall. Show the television and console in the correct right-wall perspective; television screen dark/off.
3. Keep a thin smoke-glass round or oval coffee table in the middle of the living area, subtly shifted to align with the new left sofa, with a restrained vase, bowl and books. Keep a fine beige/taupe rug scaled to this modest apartment.
4. Add one small sculptural wooden reading chair at the RIGHT REAR edge of the living area, angled slightly inward, clear of the back entry door and clear of the entry-to-living walking route.
5. Replace the rear rectangular four-seat dining table with a compact round dark-walnut pedestal dining table and exactly THREE small upholstered dining chairs. Shift the dining set subtly LEFT within the same rear dining zone, beneath the existing pendant. Keep the dining furniture compact, and keep the rear entry and left glazed opening unobstructed.
Lighting: warm daytime with natural light entering from the left; all existing warm practical fixtures switched on, approximately 2700–3000 K, realistic pools of light and contact shadows. Do not apply an overall amber filter.
Materials: premium dark walnut panels and furniture, sophisticated burgundy leather, fine rug, warm grey stone floor, photographed natural materials with truthful grain, pores, glass reflections, seams and contact shadows. Preserve the original refined Dusk material palette and existing rear shelving, rear art and sideboard.
Absolute invariants: same architecture, no room widening, no ceiling raising, no relocation or reshaping of doors or glazed openings, no extra windows, no mansion scale, no alternate camera, no mirror reversal. This is a furniture layout concept without measured dimensions, not a construction drawing.
Avoid: occluded doorways, circulation blocked by chairs, giant furniture, floating objects, CGI plastic surfaces, text, labels, logos, watermarks, people.
Return exactly one native 1536x1024 image.
